name: The Artist
source:
William is still suffering from his case of “Dwarven Fever” and goes in search of rare pornographic materials. He meets an artist who specializes in uncommon paintings and gets more than he bargained for.

[From [url=https://affect3dstore.com/the-artist.html]Affect3D[/url]]
